Moomin Valley Park is hosting a fall event called "Moomin Valley Park Harvest" from September 12 – October 25, 2026 (Reiwa 8). The event features a new terrace, the interactive show "Apple Pop Playtime!", an autumn umbrella sky, and more seasonal highlights.

【Special Services】
• September 21 (Mon., national holiday, Respect for the Aged Day): Free admission for ages 65 and up
• September 19 (Sat.) – September 23 (Wed., national holiday): Senior discount week
• Children's Support Campaign: Ages 4 through high school, 1-day pass ¥500 (regular ¥1,300)
• U22 Pass: Ages 18–22, 1-day pass ¥2,200 (regular ¥4,300, advance purchase only)

For details, visit Okuu Musashi Hanno Tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/news/%e7%89%a9%e8%aa%9e%e3%81%a8%e3%82%a2%e3%83%bc%e3%83%88%e3%81%ae%e4%b8%96%e7%95%8c%e3%81%b8%ef%bc%81%e3%80%8c%e3%83%a0%e3%83%bc%e3%83%9f%e3%83%b3%e3%83%90%e3%83%ac%e3%83%bc%e3%83%91%e3%83%bc%e3%82%af
